report_name: Qilin Ransomware Gang Leaks Burnaby School District Data on Dark Web

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A Russian-speaking ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation that conducted a double-extortion attack against the Burnaby School District. The group exfiltrated approximately one terabyte of data before encrypting systems and subsequently published the stolen data on its dark web leak site after the district refused to pay the ransom.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion of victim organizations through data encryption and the threat of public data exposure.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group deployed their ransomware payload to encrypt files across the Burnaby School District's network, causing significant operational disruption.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: As part of a double-extortion tactic, the Qilin group exfiltrated approximately one terabyte of sensitive data before deploying ransomware. The hunting hints suggest this was likely done using legitimate cloud storage services like Mega or pCloud.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used the 'vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet' command to delete volume shadow copies, preventing system recovery from local backups. This is a common ransomware TTP.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: The Qilin ransomware payload was used to encrypt systems at the Burnaby School District. It is part of a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation.

identities.name: Burnaby School District
identities.description: A school district in British Columbia, Canada, targeted by the Qilin ransomware group in September 2026. The attack resulted in data exfiltration and encryption, with sensitive student and staff data subsequently leaked on the dark web.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site operated by the Qilin ransomware group to publish data stolen from victims who refuse to pay the ransom.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c9e-7d4f-4b6a-8c1d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery. Based on hunting hints from the Qilin attack on Burnaby School District.
references:
  - https://vancouver.citynews.ca/2026/11/05/burnaby-school-district-cyberattack-former-staff/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Suspicious Large Outbound Data Transfer to Cloud Storage
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Large Outbound Data Transfer to Cloud Storage
id: 8d9e0f1a-2b3c-4d5e-b6f7-a8b9c0d1e2f3
status: experimental
description: Detects large data uploads to common cloud storage providers (Mega, pCloud), which can indicate data exfiltration prior to a ransomware attack. Based on hunting hints from the Qilin attack on Burnaby School District.
references:
  - https://vancouver.citynews.ca/2026/11/05/burnaby-school-district-cyberattack-former-staff/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|endswith:
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'pcloud.com'
    sc-bytes|gt: 100000000
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects large data uploads to common cloud storage providers, which can indicate data exfiltration prior to a ransomware attack.
